description: Live-stream ingest credentials are unmarked in the spec. Its own description of `LiveStream.stream_key` says it "should be considered as sensitive as credentials, anyone with this stream key can begin streaming"; `srt_passphrase` is "used for encrypting a stream to a Mux SRT endpoint"; the list filter `stream_key` takes the same key. A simulcast target `stream_key` is the third-party service’s stream key, and an SRT simulcast `url` is "a fully formed SRT connection string, for example: `srt://…?streamid={stream_key}&passphrase={srt_passphrase}`", so both carry credentials (https://www.mux.com/api-spec.json, components SimulcastTarget/LiveStream).
